evidence: deepseek-v4-flash: "Since m = n-1 and graph is connected, it's a tree." Both surviving solutions root the graph at 1 and perform tree-style parent/subtree processing.
affordance_in_statement: The market regulations guarantee that the proposed agreements are capable of consolidating all n corporations into a single monopoly if every agreement were to be executed. Furthermore, the total number of proposed agreements m is strictly regulated to be exactly one less than the total number of corporations n.
removal_suggestion: Replace the guarantee that all corporations can be consolidated with a guarantee only that all patent holders are mutually connectable. Keep m = n - 1, but allow disconnected graphs with cycles in irrelevant components; this preserves the objective while invalidating the assumption that the entire input is one tree.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses connectedness plus m = n - 1 to treat the input as a tree, then solves the minimum marked-vertex subtree problem with subtree counts.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The statement guarantees consolidation of all n corporations and specifies m is exactly one less than n.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Roots the graph at vertex 1 and uses parent, edge-weight, and traversal-order arrays, relying on a tree traversal rather than handling general graph structure.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The statement guarantees that all corporations can be consolidated and fixes the number of agreements at n - 1.

common_affordance: The entire agreement graph is assumed to be a connected graph with exactly n - 1 edges, so it is treated as a weighted tree.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses a generic weight-ordered DSU/heap approach instead of identifying the exact minimal subtree containing the patent holders, so it can include irrelevant low-cost edges or stop with the wrong accumulated cost.
Sorts all edges and applies Kruskal-style DSU processing, which optimizes a generic spanning-forest process rather than pruning the tree to the unique subtree connecting all patent holders.

recommended_edit: Change the connectivity guarantee from “all n corporations can be consolidated into a single monopoly” to “all patent holders are mutually connectable.” This allows disconnected non-patent components and cycles while preserving the same minimum-fee objective and input/output formats.
